circle.data-description: HIG Fan FRU LED table - Off (main board 3.3V power fail, or fan not present), Solid Green (fan present and interrupt de-assert), Blinking Yellow (fan present but interrupt assert). The table's Blinking Green and Solid Yellow rows read N/A and are deliberately not modelled

circle.data-states: off ok fail standby no-dc warning
circle.data-description: HIG PSU FRU LED table - Off (no DC power to any PSU), Green (DC output on and OK), Red (PSU failure), Flashing Green (DC present, only standby output on - poor contact), Flashing Red (no DC power to THIS PSU), Flashing between Green and Red (warning: working condition not satisfied, check voltage, current and temperature)
